description:
Get alert notifications. Unread only, unless history is set.

    Args:
        offset: Skip this many rows (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100). Unread upstream cap is 50.
        history: When true, return fired alerts including ones already read, newest first.

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_notifications
title: Get notifications
